title: GTA6 and November's Titans: Why You Need a Cosy PS5 Escape
description: As GTA6 and other major titles crowd the November release calendar, a cosy Pokémon-like Dragon Quest monster game could be the perfect PS5 escape.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A 'Clash of the Titans' Season

It is shaping up to be a true 'Clash of the Titans' kind of November, featuring heavyweights like Zelda and GTA 6 duking it out for the crown. As highlighted by Push Square, this fierce competition comes on top of the dozens upon dozens of other titles already vying for your attention throughout September and October.

## The Need for a Pace Change on PS5

With such a relentless wave of blockbuster releases, PS5 owners are bound to experience a busy and potentially exhausting gaming season. Open-world epics and massive adventures demand intense focus and countless hours of your time. After months of high-stakes gaming, players may find themselves yearning for a complete change of pace and a much-needed mental break from the intensity.

## Enter the Cosy Monster Game

This is where titles like Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World come into play. Offering a Pokémon-like monster-taming experience, it serves as the exact kind of cosy comedown your PS5 desperately needs after a packed and demanding year. Instead of stress and high-octane action, it provides a relaxing, charming escape that lets players unwind at their own comfortable rhythm.

## Editor's Take

As monumental releases like GTA 6 dominate the gaming landscape, balancing the heavy experiences with something lighthearted and cosy is essential. A relaxed monster-catching adventure might just be the best antidote to blockbuster fatigue.
